snippet.title: Podvodsk - A game about building an underwater city from the creators of Loop Hero!
snippet.description:
Play for free on itch.io https://fourquarters.itch.io/podvodsk?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt A game about building an underwater city

Drag & drop building schematics in the top right corner to build them, each schematic costing different number of points

Try to get as deep as possible!
